steps.description: The design document is a local file. I'll read it directly.

Read design_solid_h2.md once to map the scheme line (C2/C5/C3) and any geometry/boundary constraints, then select Direction A (1D MgH₂ hydrogen–thermal coupled model) as the primary deliverable and Direction C (world-model error accumulation) as the independent cross-check — because C reuses A's low-fidelity rollout as "truth", so one implementation validates both. Implement prototype/ with: (1) finite-difference explicit/semi-implicit time integration of the 1D energy equation + hydrogen absorption fraction ODE, van't Hoff equilibrium pressure and Arrhenius rate; (2) grid-independence study at Nx=50 and Nx=100 comparing charging time, peak temperature, energy residual; (3) a least-squares/ kernel one-step predictor fitted on A's trajectory, then N-step autoregressive rollout measuring error vs step with a training-size ablation (50 vs 200 samples). Write results.json with every numeric claim and report.md with the six required sections, marking Verified vs Unverified. Fixed random seed, numpy/scipy only.
